notes.title: 62 Eulengasse
notes.content:
I have now updated the demo to be more human. The rains are continuing—to the dismay of Fr. Said, and new things are revealing themselves

Project size

Encyclopedia

Proving Grounds

⦁	Fixed some practice targets not moving

⦁	Added more details around the shoreline
⦁	Fixed detonation when lyzards touched the Oyono device

notes.title: Shades of Orion
notes.content:
The prelude demo for B.C. Piezophile has just been made fully available as Steam Scream Fest 3 begins

You will once again get to experience the mech first hand

This demo also has its own dedicated store page. You play as a prospective pilot learning how to use the suit in a mostly safe training environment prior to the crash of the M.E. Atta. There are creatures and esoterica to find and read about if you so choose

I know you are enjoying this. One day it will all have to come to an end

notes.title: World Receiver
notes.content:
The beta demo for B.C. Piezophile will be playable during Steam's June 2024 Next Fest. I welcome your feedback

Soon you will be able to experience underwater mech gaming at its finest

I updated the store page description and trailer. You assume the role of a crash research investigator astrally projecting on behalf of the Monastic See

This project is a great risk and undertaking. God is in control. Enjoy
